description: What seat 0 of a seeded two-player bot game is sent by mtg-server, in order, with auto-pass and the clocks off (a seat that is stopped at every priority window). `messages` is a seat that joins a running game: Welcome, Snapshot, its pending Decision, then the last batches of the game with their Decisions and GameOver. `lobby` is a seat that joined before the start: Welcome, then the first batches from seq 0 with no Snapshot. `expected` is the seat's true StateView after the last message. Regenerate: MTG_UPDATE_BINDINGS=1 cargo test -p mtg-protocol --test transcript
